mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_transaction_log ( id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, due_date, create_time, accumulated_interest, status ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{accountId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{dueDate}, #{createTime}, #{accumulatedInterest}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bank_transaction_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND transaction_type = '1' AND status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT id, account_id AS accountId, transaction_type AS transactionType, amount, due_date AS dueDate, create_time AS createTime, accumulated_interest AS accumulatedInterest, status FROM bank_transaction_log WHERE id = #{id}
select sum(accumulated_interest - amount) as interestAndAmount from bank_transaction_log where account_id = #{accountId};
